asset-picked.notes: Picked asset lands back in the field.

asset-picker-bitmaps.notes: Asset picker navigates into a folder.

asset-picker-selected.notes: An asset cell shows as selected.

info-name-typed.notes: Typing in the name field commits.

lighting-density-committed.notes: Typed 0.25 + Return commits: field reads 0.25 and SetSunLightingCommand{groundShadowDensity:0.25} reached the command bridge (asserted).

lighting-density-editing.notes: Click on Shadow density enters inline edit: field becomes a focused text input showing 0.80. Proves click-to-edit works (it had regressed).

lighting-open.notes: Lighting editor renders; toolbar icon centring is the only diff.

picker-accepted.notes: OK applies the colour and closes the modal.

picker-dragged.notes: Dragging the SV square previews live; SetSunLightingCommand preview carries a red groundDiffuseColor (asserted).

picker-open.notes: Colour picker modal opens from the Diffuse swatch.

shell-env-tab.notes: Env tab strip unchanged; toolbar icon centring is the only diff.

shell-misc-tab.notes: Misc tab active; strip shows the one registered Misc view (Info). Content cleared on tab switch.

shell-objects-tab.notes: Objects tab now registers 4 editors (Units/Features/Properties/Collision) where the golden had none. Toolbar icons are centred in their buttons: .action-button is now a flex box, and .editor-button-panel no longer overlaps the toolbar's top 5dp (it was swallowing clicks there).

sky-open.notes: Env -> Sky renders Sun/Sky/Cloud swatches with live atmosphere colours (sun white, sky blue), the new Skybox asset button reading '(none)', and Fog colour/start/end (0.10/1.00).

water-checkbox.notes: 'Forced rendering' is checked (blue fill) after one click, and stays checked -- the engine value is read back from the result's boolValue. Exactly one SetWaterParamsCommand{forceRendering:true} was emitted.

water-open.notes: Env -> Water renders all sections (perlin, diffuse, specular, fresnel, blur, plane, texture) with live engine values matching the Lua panel: NumTiles 4, start freq 8, lacunarity 3, amplitude 0.90, specular power 20, fresnel 0.20/0.80/4.00, blur 2.00/1.50, plane colour green. Two checkboxes render unchecked. Texture asset fields are absent (not ported).
